commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
git fetch origin main agent/chatgpt-relay-developer-path
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "d02bb3537be8a99762bf1264a4691ef06c7879ad"
test "$(git rev-parse origin/agent/chatgpt-relay-developer-path)" = "0d005d820dfacc2eb584b3c7db244851a07f93d7"
git checkout -B agent/chatgpt-relay-developer-path origin/agent/chatgpt-relay-developer-path
set +e
python3 -m unittest scripts/test_chatgpt_relay_live_call.py > /tmp/chat-relay-host-red.log 2>&1
RC=$?
set -e
cat /tmp/chat-relay-host-red.log
test $RC -ne 0
grep -E 'ModuleNotFoundError|ImportError' /tmp/chat-relay-host-red.log >/dev/null
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo chatgpt_relay_host_red_verified=true
